body.name: \(\mathcal D_G\)
body.construction: Create every subset vertex \(A\subseteq V\) and the edge \(A\to A\cup\{r\}\), \(r\in U_A\), exactly when \(q^{ab}(A,r,t)=0\) for all \(t\in U_A\setminus\{r\}\) and both orientations of every \(\{a,b\}\in E\); obtain \(\mathcal D_G^{\mathrm{live}}\) by retaining exactly vertices reachable from \(\varnothing\) that can reach \(V\).
